 Arva AI, which builds AI agents for banks' financial-crime compliance teams and counts Wise as a customer, raised a $20M Series A led by Arthur Ventures   —  Arva AI, which builds AI agents for banks' financial-crime compliance teams, has raised $20 million in Series A funding, CEO Rhim Shah tells Axios Pro exclusively.
